title: Team Dominance by Pass Success
summary: Teams(player_id,team_name) maps players to teams. Passes(pass_from,time_stamp,pass_to), keyed by sender and time, records match passes. For each sending team and half, score +1 when the receiver is on the same team and -1 otherwise. Half one includes 00:00 through 45:00; half two is 45:01 through 90:00. Return team_name, half_number and dominance_score in ascending team/half order. Verify whether zero-pass team/half rows must be emitted.
